title: Service card system
slide_intent: Give different service messages a shared structure so users can scan varied content without relearning the layout.
strategic_value: Consistent cards can connect Xfinity’s support, offers, appointments and entertainment recommendations.
demonstration: A loose grid of white cards combines colored headings and top rules with product images, an appointment, usage summaries, offers and assistance.
practical_value: Compare card density and emphasis across message types before choosing a reusable content pattern.

content_islands.name: Card field
content_islands.spec: Arrange varied card sizes across a pale gray canvas while preserving consistent white surfaces and modest shadows.

content_islands.name: Colored headings and rules
content_islands.spec: Use colored headings or thin top rules to distinguish messages within the common card structure.

content_islands.name: Content examples
content_islands.spec: Retain the mixture of products, numbers, dates, entertainment imagery and help copy to test the system’s range.

ingredient.name: Service cards
ingredient.role: Make varied messages scannable within one interface family.
ingredient.application: Use a shared white surface, clear heading and controlled color accents while varying card height and imagery with content.
ingredient.scope: Observed card collection; no universal grid measurements or fixed color-to-service mapping are supplied.

reference_purposes.Expression: Thin colored rules, clear headings and white surfaces repeat across the collection.
reference_purposes.Application: The cards accommodate appointments, usage, offers, product instructions and help.
